name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Use a 3px solid #005fcc focus ring with a 1px white stroke at 50% opacity. This makes the ring visible on all backgrounds while keeping it unobtrusive. The thicker ring improves keyboard navigation visibility, especially on high-contrast or dark themes. Trade-off: it takes slightly more space, but that’s acceptable for accessibility.

name: Reader
text: A 3px ring fails on mobile/touch where fat fingers need 4px+ tap targets. Use a 2px ring with a 2px inner glow at 30% opacity instead—same visibility, less space. Test on a 320px viewport with 44px buttons; if touch fails, the glow wins.
